title: query unit-usage
summary: Answers one question, about one unit and one file

help: WITH --in: of that unit's exports, which does THIS file reference? Empty = dead import.
WITHOUT --in: which files reference the unit at all, and which merely IMPORT it.
The candidate set is the uses graph -- in Delphi you cannot name an export without a uses entry.

pitfalls: omit --in for the project-wide answer; add --in `<F.pas>` to ask about ONE file.

for an RTL/VCL/third-party unit pass the platform library DB too (--db `<proj>` --db `<library>`) for the reference breakdown. With the project DB alone you still get the importer list; only the --in form exits 2.
